label: CRS326-24G-2S+IN
description: MikroTik CRS326-24G-2S+IN — 24x 1G RJ45, 2x 10G SFP+, dual-boot RouterOS/SwOS.
notes: MikroTik spec table, row Ethernet '10/100/1000 Ethernet ports: 24' and row Fiber 'SFP+ ports: 2'; the product text adds "SFP cage supports both 1.25 Gb SFP and 10 Gb SFP+ modules", so the two cages carry speedCaps 1000/10000. Copper ports are 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ45 sockets, which is what the template now declares. Desktop case, passive PoE-in on the DC jack, not PoE-out on any port. Source: https://mikrotik.com/product/crs326_24g_2s_in
